category.description: The Forge catalog category containing the comparison group.

taskDefinition.description: A precise definition of the task family, including what is outside its scope.

selectionQuestions.description: Questions an agent must answer before selecting a model in this group.

comparabilityRules.description: Protocol conditions that must match before benchmark values may be compared.

decisionRules.description: Evidence-backed conditional routing rules among exact models in this group.

when.description: The use case, constraint set, or decision condition.

prefer.description: One exact candidate Forge model slug to prefer under this condition, or the literal insufficient-evidence when primary evidence cannot support a winner. Never use an upstream repository ID, display name, family, or prose.

because.description: The criterion-specific evidence supporting the preference.

alternatives.description: Other distinct exact candidate Forge slugs. Never repeat the preferred slug or duplicate an alternative. Put the condition for preferring an alternative in its own decision rule; do not put prose or upstream repository IDs here.

items.description: One exact slug from the supplied Forge candidate list.

evidenceUrls.description: Primary-source URLs supporting the decision rule.

benchmarkTaxonomy.description: The accepted tasks, datasets, metrics, and comparison controls for this group.

task.description: A benchmarkable task within this group.

datasets.description: Canonical or relevant dataset names as plain strings. Do not return objects, URLs, or name/source pairs here; cite sources only through the dossier's top-level sources list.

items.description: One dataset name, optionally including a version or split, encoded as a single string.

metrics.description: Metrics that are meaningful for the task, including their direction and aggregation where relevant.

comparisonConditions.description: Conditions that must match for results on this task to be compared.

sources.description: Primary publications, official model cards, repositories, or documentation supporting the group taxonomy and decisions.

publisher.description: The model creator, repository owner, standards body, or paper venue.

primary.description: True only for first-party documentation, official repositories/model cards, or original research publications.

supports.description: The specific taxonomy or decision claims supported by this source.

evidenceGaps.description: Missing head-to-head evaluations, incomparable protocols, absent operational data, or other limits preventing a definitive routing rule.
